get.description:
Hybrid semantic search: visual frames + speech (semantic and keyword) + highlight events, fused with RRF.

One result per session, resolved to the clip containing the best moment, or a suggested
±15 s window when no clip contains it.

post.description: Generate transcripts, summaries, and platform-ready metadata from one video.

liked_by_me.description: Only set when X-User-Id is sent

status.title: Status
status.description: 'none' = never requested for this clip range; POST to start

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= to get the next page; null at the end

offset_ms.title: Offset Ms
offset_ms.description: Moment time relative to the result's start_ms (where to seek in its playlist)

label.title: Label
label.description: Event type when a highlight event matched, e.g. 'clutch'

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 'clip' when an existing clip contains the match; otherwise 'session' with a suggested window

match_t_ms.title: Match T Ms
match_t_ms.description: The exact moment to seek to, in session time

start_ms.title: Start Ms
start_ms.description: Clip start, or start of the suggested window

end_ms.title: End Ms
end_ms.description: Clip end, or end of the suggested window

score.title: Score
score.description: Raw fusion score; only meaningful for ordering

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the match is, 0..1, comparable across queries

other_moments_ms.title: Other Moments Ms
other_moments_ms.description: Further good matches in the same session

moments.title: Moments
moments.description: Best moment first, then the others, with details

SessionStatusEvent.title: SessionStatusEvent
SessionStatusEvent.description: Payload of each `status` event on GET /sessions/{id}/status (server-sent events).

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When the recording started, if the client knows

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: Presigned URL. PUT the raw file bytes here with the given headers.
